{"notes": "Visit 4 (left 6:30). Picture: the chain is dark from the start through the back to about (23, 9.3), and the belly runs through the bottom tail up to a dark domino near (27, 8.9). The whole pale tail, from about (27.4, 9.3) up and around to (26, 5.3), is still pale. The back's end and the pale tail's start (about (23.5, 9.4)) are still unbridged. I can't tell who placed what, so no credit or blame for chain state until the final push.

Sofia: Reversed her plan again, now saying no more lifting; the tail is to get its fall from the belly side. This drops the top join she'd been working on. She still communicates clearly and asked Omar to shout when the bridge is in. Collaboration is strong, but her plan keeps shifting and execution is unproven. Ask privately what she's worried about.

Omar: Said the bridge is in and the last domino is up into the tail's top. The picture shows dark dominoes reaching the tail's lower end, but the tail itself is not dark, so his claim is only partly borne out. Credit that he's checking the right edge and told people to hold off. Next visit: did the tail go dark, and does he know the back-end join is open?

Hana: Not heard this visit. Earlier she was hands-off and gave good advice. Still need her view privately on how she used her time.

Jack: Silent again, no rating basis. Ask him privately."}
